Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat\(trout-poker\): Migrate data storage from Whop API hacks to Vercel Blob

Replace three fragile storage patterns with Vercel Blob JSON documents:
- Payout requests: were JSON-stuffed in a hidden product description
- Tournament metadata: were JSON-stuffed in product descriptions
- User roles: were stored in data/users.json \(broken on Vercel read-only FS\)

All API routes now use db.ts abstraction layer with deterministic blob paths
\(users/{id}.json, tournaments/{id}.json, payout-requests/{id}.json\).
Whop API still handles all financial operations \(checkout, transfers, memberships\).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(gh pr create --title "feat\(trout-poker\): Migrate data storage to Vercel Blob" --body "$\(cat <<''EOF''
## Summary

- Replace three fragile storage hacks \(JSON in Whop product descriptions, filesystem JSON\) with **Vercel Blob** document store
- Add `src/lib/db.ts` abstraction layer — all 13 API routes use it, Whop API still handles financial ops
- Delete `user-store.ts` and `data/users.json` \(was broken on Vercel''s read-only FS\)
- Update SPEC.md to reflect Blob storage architecture

## Test plan

- [ ] Add Blob Store in Vercel project Storage tab

- [ ] Enter tournament — checkout still works via Whop
- [ ] Submit payout request — stored in `payout-requests/{id}.json`
- [ ] Approve request in admin — transfer executes, blob updated
- [ ] User roles persist across requests

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code]\(https://claude.com/claude-code\)
EOF
\)")
